records.rationale: Test names a layout id; regenerate or update the fixture when the id moves.

decision: Append only the reviewed F01 floor-membership dependency used to validate the complete original cabinet/dryer records against the source floor. It resolves to the existing floor and V2 blockout. Future explicit layout changes must regenerate this test fixture. All prior rows stay exact; no blanket manifest update, geometry relocation or acceptance is granted.
